answer: Each agent must lock a jade-bonded stake before it can trade: a refundable deposit that only unlocks after a full epoch of honest work. A Sybil attacker who spawns a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand bonds, so the cost of forgery scales linearly while the gain stays flat. Bonds are slashed on proven fraud and released slowly, like a comet that burns bright then fades, so one honest agent earns its stake back at dawn of the next epoch while a swarm of fakes bleeds capital with every attempt.
